dedupe_keys.name: daily port activity data shipment estimates 37 data sets portwatch on hdx

description: Daily Port Activity Data Shipment Estimates (37 data sets, PortWatch, on HDX) is a series of data sets listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by PortWatch. Daily count of port calls, estimates of incoming shipment volumes and outgoing shipment volumes (in metric tons) for ports in Mozambique. Coverage: Angola, Benin, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Côte d'Ivoire, Cameroon, Cabo Verde and 31 more. The portal lists 37 near-identical data sets in this series (one per event, year, area or country), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher PortWatch. Its tags are ports, trade. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
